data.narrative:
Addionics is a Series B climate and energy technology company that has raised $39M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-sector, same-to-adjacent-stage companies: KoBold Metals ($3.0B, Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B, Series C), and Amogy ($700M, Series C), anchoring the sector comparable universe alongside a broader set of eight private peers and one public comparable.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy anchor, applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $74M. Peer-median analysis across the three-company comp set produces $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. The spread reflects variance in stage maturity and technology scope within the Climate & Energy sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $63M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $537M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around comparable company selection and stage-adjusted positioning within the peer set. The peer-median method pulls substantially higher than stage-progression, suggesting that either (1) Addionics commands meaningful technical or market differentiation relative to its capital raised, or (2) the Series C comparable set overstates near-term valuation potential. Revenue traction, IP defensibility, and exact stage positioning relative to named peers are critical resolving factors not present in this analysis.
